shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,95p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; rg -n -C 4 'i18n|international|language' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; cat package.json; cat src/main.tsx; cat src/App.tsx; rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!dist/**'"'"
